title: Blind-review findings artifact
description: The artifact a blind code review writes to .claude/.review/current.json. review_verify.sh is the authoritative gate; this schema documents the shape. The verdict is COMPUTED by the reviewer over the diff, and re-verified against the diff by review_verify.sh — it is never a self-asserted stamp.

base.description: Full sha of HEAD when the review was stamped (`review_verify.sh --emit-base`). The gate re-renders the current tree against this commit, so committing the reviewed work keeps the artifact fresh while any later edit makes it stale. Absent, or not a full sha (e.g. a symbolic ref), the gate checks only the uncommitted diff (`git diff HEAD` + untracked).

diff_sha.description: sha256 of the exact diff that was reviewed (`review_verify.sh --emit-sha`). The gate recomputes the current diff (against `base` when present) and refuses the artifact if this does not match (edited-after-review => stale).

reviewed_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the review was produced.

verdict.description: pass = no critical findings; changes-requested = at least one critical finding.

findings.description: Every finding must cite a real changed line: review_verify.sh rejects the artifact if any file:line is not in the current diff.

line.description: 1-indexed new-file line, must fall in a changed hunk of the diff.

category.description: Short kebab-case slug, e.g. correctness, n+1, authorization, operator-task.

failure_scenario.description: Concrete inputs/state -> wrong output/crash. The evidence the finding is real.

evidence.description: For a structural claim, the ground-truth introspection run (bin/rails runner / rails-mcp / schema); otherwise the quoted code or reasoning.
